chunks: So, if they turn away, say: 'God is sufficient for me; there is no god but He; upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the glorious Throne.'

key_terms.تَوَكَّلْتُ: I have relied / entrusted my affairs

ai.seo_question: What should one say when others turn away from the message of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the Prophet's ultimate reliance on God amidst the rejection of the Quraysh, serving as a model for believers to maintain spiritual independence when facing opposition. The declaration 'Hasbiya Allah' underscores the concept of divine sufficiency, linking the Prophet's personal trust (Tawakkul) with God's absolute sovereignty over the 'Great Throne' (Al-Arsh Al-Azeem), a key attribute in Shi'a theological discussions on divine power and authority.
